crossRefs.note: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.
“Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

parallels.note: “ ‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.
On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

translations.web: “ ‘ “In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
translations.bsb: On the fourteenth day of the first month you are to observe the Passover, a feast of seven days, during which unleavened bread shall be eaten.
translations.kjv: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
translations.asv: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
